title: Bound EUR byte00 RAM substitution buffer references
changes: Identify conditional producers and source uses of the RAM buffer copied by one text-substitution callback.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-ram-source-literals-wine-rl7cunl4 finds seven exact aligned literal load candidates in the bounded EUR code scan; Wine e158-byte00-ram-source-dis-wine-1o2klth5 examines their original instruction windows.
Two conditional sites expand short-string selector 2 into the RAM buffer before using it as a CpuSet source; the callback uses that address as an input to the text expander.
limitations: Actual buffer contents at callback time, writer exclusivity, callback invocation and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved; address arithmetic, aliases, indirect references, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
